description: This file declares the GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate class, which manages decryption of GStreamer buffers within a media processing pipeline. It includes methods for decrypting buffers, setting decryption services, and managing protection metadata, indicating its role in media decryption and protection handling.

classes.name: GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate
classes.description: A class responsible for decrypting GStreamer buffers, managing decryption services, and handling protection metadata within the Rialto media framework.

methods.name: GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decryptor with a parent element and a GStreamer wrapper factory.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on a GStreamer buffer using the configured decryption service.

methods.name: setDecryptionService
methods.description: Sets the decryption service object used for buffer decryption.

methods.name: setProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Sets the protection metadata wrapper object.

methods.name: createProtectionMetaInfo
methods.description: Creates a GStreamer structure containing protection metadata based on provided protection data.
